hero.title: Vellore Institute of Technology
hero.summary: VIT’s School of Agricultural Innovations and Advanced Learning teaches agriculture at the Vellore campus. Its 2026 admission portal sets out a merit-based route without an entrance examination, while the school describes research, farm learning and outreach programmes for local farming communities.

overview.heading: A Vellore agriculture school with clear 2026 entry rules
paragraphs: VAIAL is VIT’s School of Agricultural Innovations and Advanced Learning. Its published activities combine degree teaching, agricultural research and farmer outreach. The school describes facilities for crop and horticultural work, analytical teaching laboratories, botanical and medicinal gardens, composting and farm machinery. Its events record includes training on organic farming, coconut cultivation and vegetable value addition.

The 2026-27 agriculture portal provides unusually specific applicant information: selection uses qualifying-examination merit, followed by online counselling. It states academic, residency and age conditions, and publishes three tuition categories. These are Vellore agriculture rules; applicants should not assume the same process applies to other VIT campuses or engineering programmes.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: Agricultural science at the Vellore campus, taught through VAIAL with field, laboratory and outreach resources.
programmes.eligibility: 2026-27: Resident Indian; born on/after 1 July 2006; 60% overall and 60% in PCB, with published 10% relaxation for specified categories/regions; English required.
programmes.admission_route: 2026-27 portal: no entrance test; qualifying PCB merit ranking and online counselling.

fees.note: Category 1 tuition. Category 2: INR 1,95,000; Category 3: INR 2,25,000 annually. One-time refundable caution deposit INR 5,000.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: VIT’s 2026 agriculture portal describes registration, application completion, payment and online counselling. Counselling eligibility does not guarantee a seat; allocation depends on rank and availability.
eligibility_points: 2026-27 academic requirements are 60% overall and 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
A published 10% relaxation applies to SC/ST applicants and specified regions; supporting certificates are required.
Resident Indian nationality and the published birth-date condition apply.

steps.title: Register and complete the application
steps.text: Use an active email address and Indian mobile number; the portal verifies the mobile number by OTP.

steps.title: Pay and upload the photograph
steps.text: The portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700 application payment and a JPG/JPEG photograph.

steps.title: Participate in counselling
steps.text: Shortlisted applicants attend online counselling based on the qualifying-examination rank list.

steps.title: Enter fee-category preferences during online counselling
steps.text: The 2026–27 portal asks shortlisted applicants to enter preferred fee categories and review their choices. It states that allotment is rank-based; individual results require the applicant’s own login.

documents: Birth certificate or passport copy as age proof.
Class XII mark statements for all attempts.
Nativity certificate for the specified North-Eastern states or Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh categories.
JPG/JPEG photograph of20–300kB and scanned signature of5–150kB, following the portal dimensions.

faqs.question: Is an entrance examination required for VIT agriculture in 2026?
faqs.answer: The dedicated 2026 portal explicitly says no entrance examination; selection uses qualifying-examination merit and counselling.

faqs.question: Are mathematics-only applicants eligible under the 2026 rules?
faqs.answer: The 2026 portal requires Physics, Chemistry and Biology; older prospectuses show different combinations. Use the current portal.

faqs.question: What is the application cost?
faqs.answer: The 2026 portal specifies a non-refundable INR 700.

faqs.question: Why are three tuition figures shown?
faqs.answer: VIT publishes annual tuition categories of INR 1,10,000, INR 1,95,000 and INR 2,25,000 for the 2026-27 intake.

faqs.question: Which campus offers the researched course?
faqs.answer: The dedicated application portal identifies the Vellore campus.
